name: hermes-memory-wiki
description: Build tooling for the Memory Wiki dashboard plugin bundle (dashboard/dist/index.js). React comes from the host SDK at runtime; nothing is bundled but this plugin's own code.

scripts.build: esbuild dashboard/src/index.jsx --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --jsx-factory=React.createElement --jsx-fragment=React.Fragment --banner:js="/* hermes-memory-wiki dashboard bundle — built from dashboard/src/index.jsx with esbuild; edit the source, run npm run build. MIT, (c) 2026 Nous Research; original by @Araja119 (hermes-agent #31244). */" --outfile=dashboard/dist/index.js
